name: SMK-37 FM6 internal engine
maker: M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro running Classic Tabby

midiIn.connector: none: the internal engine of the SMK-37 itself, not a MIDI device
midiIn.note: A Tabby track plays the engine when its SEQ setting (SEQ page 6/7 MIDI TRACK, K3) is LOCAL or BOTH. Set the pinned track to LOCAL so nothing leaves on this channel.

clock.syncs: the SMK-37 is the clock master

channelSetting: A convention: channel 9 parts land on the pinned Tabby track (track 8 in the Wrong Room profile); on the device, once, SEQ page 6/7: track 8 K3 SEQ = LOCAL.

channel.note: Convention only: no external device listens on it. The importer puts a part on this channel on the pinned Tabby track whatever its file order and writes OUT CH 9; with SEQ = LOCAL on that track nothing is sent.

programChange.note: Row events never reach the internal engine (SPEC 8): the sound of the pinned track is the project's. A program event on this channel does nothing inside and, with SEQ = LOCAL, leaves on no port.

setup: On the device, once: SEQ page 6/7 MIDI TRACK, select track 8, K3 SEQ = LOCAL (BOTH would also send the part on channel 9 to every port).
Give track 8 the sound you want in the project (SHIFT + HOME, SAVE) and save the project.
In the file, the FM6 part is the track on channel 9; its program changes and CCs are ignored.
notes: The engine is per Tabby track, not per channel: any track with SEQ LOCAL or BOTH sounds inside. The channel-9 convention and the track pin make an imported part land on the FM6 without hand work.
FM6 preview timing is one audio block looser than MIDI out (SPEC 9.6).

sources.title: Classic Tabby SPEC.md sections 6, 8 and 9 (song notes follow the SEQ setting; events never reach the internal engine)
